Sophia (Solutions): EmberBank asked for a customer-specific variant: instruct-oriented, 64k context, and aggressive quant (int8/int4 exploration). They want priority onboarding next week, enterprise SLA. Any objections?
Maria (ML Eng): Noted. Need to confirm exact base model they want us to fork. Do we have a legal/data classification note from Sales? PII constraints change caching and logging.
Sophia (Solutions): @Maria sales sent a short note: "sensitive financial summaries only, no raw PII allowed in logs; must run in Dedicated or Private." They prefer Dedicated but will consider Private if latency suffers.
Chao (Research): For 64k instruct builds we should start from a base that's already long-context friendly. Candidate: emberbase-7b-lc (our internal name). Quant plan: run int8 first, then int4 sweep on a few eval sets. Key checks: perplexity delta, instruction-following accuracy, and hallucination regressions on our financial eval suite.
Alex (SRE): Capacity check: Dedicated pool can handle 2x 7B concurrent with 64k if we reserve 1 node (A100-class). Need formal capacity request by EOD to avoid conflicts with scheduled maintenance.
Maria (ML Eng): Proposed bring-up checklist (high level):
  1) Intake confirm: dataset/PII, SLA, traffic pattern, expected qps.
  2) Baseline perf: run 1k sample prompts on emberbase-7b-lc float32 to get latency/cost.
  3) Quant experiments: int8 latency/cost + quality check; int4 if int8 acceptable.
  4) Evals: instruction-following, hallucination suite, rouge/emd as applicable.
  5) Canary: dedicated node canary with 5% traffic for 24h.
  6) Rollout + monitoring: attach eval regression alerts and token-level cost dashboards.
Chao (Research): Adding specifics for evals: include these tests
  - Financial-summary-factuality v2 (200 prompts)
  - Balance-sheet-sensitive redaction test (50 prompts with dummy PII to ensure model redacts)
  - Latency sensitivity: 16k, 32k, 64k sequence lengths (50 each)
Maria (ML Eng): Quick sample command to run the baseline eval (internal tool):
```
# run on research cluster
redwood eval run --model emberbase-7b-lc --suite fin-summary-v2 --samples 200 --out results/emberbank/baseline.json
```
Sophia (Solutions): Sales will push contract but flagged "enterprise SLA + compliance review". We should treat as P1 for onboarding queue.
Alex (SRE): I'll provision the Dedicated pool tentatively, naming it emberbank-dedicated-1. I'll mark it pending until research confirms memory footprint for quant artifacts.
Chao (Research): For int8 quick test, I'll run a 50-sample sweep overnight and post results. If int8 drops instruction-following by >3% we stop and try different quant config.
deploy-bot: Job created: "emberbank-int8-sweep-179888" scheduled by Chao. ETA: 12h.
Maria (ML Eng): Can we get Prometheus alerts tied to the eval regressions? Suggest thresholds: instruction-following drop >2% or hallucination false-positive >1% triggers rollback.
Alex (SRE): Yes, add per-variant alerting and an automatic fallback route to emberbase-7b-lc-float32. I'll add the fallback policy to the canary config.
Sophia (Solutions): Great. Next steps: Chao runs sweep, Maria consolidates results and produces a quick 1-pager for Sales/Legal, Alex preps Dedicated node. I'll follow up with Sales to confirm contract timelines. :thumbsup:
Chao (Research): Starting sweep now, will post initial numbers in this thread when done.
Maria (ML Eng): Thanks — please include sample prompts and seed set so we can reproduce.
Sophia (Solutions): Copy that. Thanks everyone.
